prompt:
Scene:
Compose a square brunch tabletop image with layered tableware, generous daylight, and a sense of weekend abundance that still feels organized enough for real hospitality and publishing use. The scene should balance multiple objects without losing the hero focal point, making table choreography and dish relationships a core part of the image. Preserve the same daylight, tableware, and airy tabletop environment, but let the hero plate occupy more of the frame with one offset glass and side plate.

Subject:
The food must look fresh, warm, and genuinely shareable: eggs, breads, fruit, spreads, juices, and plated brunch mains should feel cooked and plated for service, not arranged as fake prop food. Show eggs Benedict or a comparable brunch egg dish with glossy sauce, crisp bread base, greens, and believable yolk tension.

Important details:
Table logic matters. Plates, glasses, linens, and serving utensils need believable spacing, overlap, and hierarchy so the image can support menus, social assets, and campaign layouts. Make the abundance feel intentional rather than chaotic, with appetizing textures and natural daylight carrying the mood. Preserve the exact camera height, lens feel, prop family, tabletop scale, palette discipline, and brand logic established by 01-weekend-table-anchor. Keep the visual language from the anchor image intact while making egg texture, sauce sheen, and toasted bread structure the central physical story.

Use case:
Brunch Tabletop series study 2/9, built for Prompt Atlas coverage of a food and beverage commercial visual system.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no buffet chaos, no greasy diner styling unless specifically implied, no visible phone screens, no plastic takeaway packaging, no fake stock-family posing, no unreadable signage, no exaggerated yolk explosion, no greasy fry-up, no cheap café cups.
title: Eggs Benedict Corner
description: A plated eggs Benedict variation that keeps the reference table system while tightening focus on sauce and breakfast precision.
